# American Pavers & Turf

> Master hardscape contractors specializing in luxury interlocking pavers, drought-tolerant synthetic turf, custom outdoor kitchens, and resort pool decks across Southern California.

## Overview
- Website: https://americanpavers.gdtwo.com
- License: California State License Board (CSLB) Class B & C-27 #984210
- Phone: (800) 555-8873
- Email: estimates@americanpaversandturf.com
- Service Areas: Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, Pasadena, Beverly Hills, Newport Beach, Irvine, Palm Springs, and Ventura County.
- Warranty: 25-Year Master Craftsmanship & Structural Guarantee.

## Core Services
- [Driveway Pavers](https://americanpavers.gdtwo.com/services/driveway-pavers): 10,000+ PSI compressive strength interlocking pavers engineered to withstand heavy RVs and eliminate cracked concrete.
- [Patio Pavers](https://americanpavers.gdtwo.com/services/patio-pavers): Architectural backyard patios with polymeric sand locking, thermal cool-touch travertine, and integrated seating walls.
- [Pool Deck Pavers](https://americanpavers.gdtwo.com/services/pool-deck-pavers): ADA-compliant wet-traction slip-resistant pool surrounds with smooth bullnose coping.
- [Synthetic Turf](https://americanpavers.gdtwo.com/services/synthetic-turf): Antimicrobial zeolite pet infill, heat-dissipating Cool-Blade technology, draining 30+ inches/hr.
- [Outdoor Kitchens & Fire Pits](https://americanpavers.gdtwo.com/services/outdoor-kitchens): Welded steel-frame BBQ islands with 304 marine stainless steel appliances and natural gas fire pits.
- [Decks & Louvered Pergolas](https://americanpavers.gdtwo.com/services/decking-pergolas): Motorized 180° louvered pergolas with automatic rain sensors and Trex composite decking.
